name: cccollab
description: Real-time collaboration between Claude Code sessions via channels and threaded topics

profile.title: Profile (optional)
profile.description: Namespaces the local broker process (rendezvous file, pid, log). Sessions sharing a profile share a broker and its channels/topics. Leave blank to join the default shared broker. Set a unique value (e.g. 'test') to run an isolated broker alongside the default.
